discription: A percussive, plucked sound generated by filtering a short noise burst with a resonant low-pass filter, suitable for short, sharp attacks.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, pan=0, dec=0.5; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(0.001, dec, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = WhiteNoise.ar(amp * env); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, freq, rq); sig = Pan2.ar(sig, pan); Out.ar(out, sig); }
